description: The empty selector on a set of an unknown kty, a 1024-bit RSA key and a P-256 key returns the P-256 key; decided by ADR 0054 §3 (ADR 0041 §2): the unknown kty member 0 and the RSA member 1 with a modulus under 2048 bits are skipped at import (RFC 7517 §5, SHOULD ignore), and the empty selector matches every member left (§1.3), of which there is one; outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose
